children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a support at $7.65 per bushel, a break below which could open the way toward the $7.54-3/4 to $7.59-3/4 range.
A rising wedge has been more or less confirmed as a top pattern, as its lower trendline has been broken. The pattern suggests a moderate target of $7.54-3/4.
A more bearish triple-top will become valid once the market breaks $7.54-3/4. Resistance is at $7.81-1/2, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $7.89-3/4 to $7.98-1/4 range.
On the daily chart, the uptrend would remain intact despite the current correction. The wave pattern indicates the development of a wave 4, which will be reversed by an upward wave 5.
The wave 4 is supposed to end around $7.51-3/4, as a further fall below may open the way toward $7.30. The wave count has to be revised.
